question_text: What is "frame bursting"? Also, give 1 advantage and disadvantage compared to the carrier extension.
reference_answer:
Frame bursting reduces the overhead for transmitting small frames by concatenating a sequence of multiple frames in one single transmission, without ever releasing control of the channel.
Advantage: it is more efficient than carrier extension as single frames not filled up with garbage.
Disadvantage: need frames waiting for transmission or buffering and delay of frames
rubric:
Total 3 marks:
1) Definition of frame bursting (1 mark)
2) One advantage compared to carrier extension (1 mark)
3) One disadvantage compared to carrier extension (1 mark)

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Define frame bursting as concatenating multiple frames into one transmission without releasing the channel.
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL = at least 2 of the 3 definition parts present (concatenate multiple frames / one transmission / without releasing channel); PARTIAL = exactly 1 part; ABSENT = 0
evidence_facets: concatenating a sequence of multiple frames
without ever releasing control of the channel
acceptable_variants: sending several frames at once without giving up the channel
grouping frames into one transmission to save overhead
keeping the channel busy to send multiple frames together
combining frames into a single burst transmission
cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: Frame bursting reduces the overhead for transmitting small frames by concatenating a sequence of multiple frames in one single transmission, without ever releasing control of the channel.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Identify the advantage of frame bursting over carrier extension regarding efficiency.
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: FULL if student states an efficiency/throughput advantage of frame bursting (vs carrier extension or in general). Accept paraphrases: more efficient, higher efficiency, better performance, higher transmission rate, improved throughput, more user data / less padding/garbage. Typos of efficiency count. Do NOT require the exact phrase 'than carrier extension' if efficiency/throughput is clear.
evidence_facets: more efficient / higher efficiency than carrier extension
higher transmission rate or improved throughput
more user data / not filled with garbage or padding
acceptable_variants: it avoids wasting space with padding
it is more efficient because it doesn't use garbage bits
it performs better than carrier extension by avoiding filler data
it saves bandwidth by not filling frames with useless data
higher transmission rate with high efficiency
improved throughput compared to carrier extension
carrier extension has low efficiency; bursting is better

cqa_tuples.source_reference_span: Advantage: it is more efficient than carrier extension as single frames not filled up with garbage.

cqa_tuples.knowledge_point: Identify the disadvantage of frame bursting regarding transmission requirements or delay.
cqa_tuples.target_criteria: any of: need frames waiting / buffering / delay of frames counts as the disadvantage
acceptable_variants: it requires frames to be buffered before sending
it introduces latency while waiting for enough frames
it causes a delay because it needs to wait for more data
it relies on having frames ready to transmit
